# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

- A sibling run on the same seed (`reused_seed_run/run_suite/candidates/*` + rollouts) held a measured 0.95 candidate and four refuted follow-ups, but RUNMAP/LEDGER of this run did not mention it — it had to be discovered by browsing. Surface sibling/reused runs (path + per-candidate score + broke/fixed) in RUNMAP.md so proposers build on them instead of re-deriving.

## cand_0002
- Infra-errored tasks (sandbox 500, trace=None) stay in the val denominator. With 2/40 errored, the reachable max is 0.95 + noise. Retrying infra-errored rollouts before scoring would stop them from masking real deltas.
- The "git diff" in the candidate work dir shows nothing, because work/ is not tracked by the run_suite repo. A ready-made `diff vs parent` helper would let the optimizer check its own patch.
